## Data Wrangle

### Combine isolate data with iNat data

```{r}
sites <- read.csv("https://github.com/jmhulbert/swordfern/raw/refs/heads/main/data/field/sword.fern.field.sample.data.csv")
isolates <- read.csv("https://github.com/jmhulbert/swordfern/raw/refs/heads/main/data/lab/sword.fern.isolates.csv")
extractions <- read.csv("https://github.com/jmhulbert/swordfern/raw/refs/heads/main/data/lab/sword.fern.isolate.extractions.august.csv")
```

```{r}
intersect(names(isolates), names(extractions))
```


```{r}
isolates <- isolates %>% rename(Initial.Results = Tentative.Results..Internal.NCBI.Oomcycete.including.voucher.blast.)
isolates$Initial.Result[isolates$Initial.Result=="Phytophthora europaea or abietivora?"] <- "Phytophthora sp."
isolates$Initial.Result[isolates$Initial.Result=="Phytophthora flexuosa?"] <- "Phytophthora sp."

isolates <- isolates[c("Isolate.ID","Initial.Results")]

```


```{r}
extractions <- extractions %>% rename(Sample = Sample.Number..Soil.or.Tissue.)
extractions <- extractions[-c(10:21,24:25,27:30)]
```

```{r}
extractions <- extractions %>% filter(Sample.Extraction.Number!="FHL0167")
```

```{r}

# in isolates this sample is listed twice: FZJ074-1 Root Elongisporangium anandrum
isolates <- isolates |>
  group_by(Isolate.ID) |>
  summarise(
    across(everything(), ~ first(.x[!is.na(.x)], default = NA)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# in extractions this sample is listed twice: FHL0099 - FZJ004-2 Soil
extractions <- extractions |>
  group_by(Sample.Extraction.Number) |>
  summarise(
    across(everything(), ~ first(.x[!is.na(.x)], default = NA)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


```{r}
results <- left_join(extractions,isolates,join_by("Isolate.Name"=="Isolate.ID"))
```


```{r}
results <- left_join(results,sites,join_by("Sample"=="Sample.ID"))
```
